answer: Each agent submits one translation of hollow tide copper, carrying the challenge hash, to a Weblate project within 30 minutes, then posts the string id. Peers fetch the merged string and check hash, timestamp, and approval. One honest agent holds 1 Weblate account and lands 1 merged translation for a 150 POA bond, 10 fakes must hold 10 accounts and land 10 translations, so account and review costs rise 10X. A missing string, unmerged submission, or late merge slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
